paper.method: Guarded disk-centre lattice on the unfolded capsule. Four-neighbour connectivity; analytic outline and chord-distance refinement near threshold.
limitations: This replaces the Python GEOS offset implementation; numerical results are not identical.
Pass/fail concern this guarded discrete rolling-disk model, not stress or tear resistance.
Uncertain is not accepted by the strict material-core gate. Increase resolution to investigate.
Small tips and features below the explicitly stated area threshold are not certified.

visualInspection.scope: First photo of all 128 designs plus canonical/photo/crop/coverage panels for indices 0,1,24,49,72,113,122,123.
visualInspection.result: No broken silhouettes or label alignment defects observed at contact-sheet scale. Difficult pale palettes and crop offsets are represented. Flat paper and procedural backgrounds still look synthetic; no real-photo accuracy claim.

limitations: Synthetic 2D images supplement real photographs; they do not establish real-world accuracy.
Procedural recipe groups are limited and share simplified routing topologies; this is not topology-disjoint evaluation. View count is not motif/topology diversity.
Graph labels are valid witnesses, not unique ground truth; unlisted connections must not automatically become negative examples.
Geometry and nominal paper-core checks are numerical and do not certify physical assembly.
Independent renderer comparison is raster evidence, not a proof of exact equality.

changes: Describe recipe holdout accurately; simplified routing topologies cross recipe groups.

reproductionNote: Generation command describes original frozen producer source hashes. Later metadata correction is recorded separately; current generator also excludes color phase from geometry deduplication and describes recipe holdout accurately.
